'''First [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]]''' was a rank in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].

This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="PFS">{{TORcite|type=enemy|Pierce's First Sergeant|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>
